name: Excavation Tools
objectiveText: Return 6 Excavation Tools to Magmar Fellhew. Excavation Tools (Provided)  ( 6 )

comments.body:
These are found all over the dig site as lootable [b]objects[/b]. Click/hover [url=https://www.wowhead.com/forever/object=665282/excavation-tools#map]here[/url] to see all spawn points.

Complete together with [quest=297] at around level 18+ if you plan to go solo, as some of the mobs here go up to level 20 [i](and rare spawns up to 21-22)[/i].
